title: Affine chart criterion and Zariski locality for scheme local quasi-finiteness
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The following conditions are equivalent: (1) $f$ is locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite]; (2) for every pair of affine opens $A\subseteq X$, $B\subseteq S$ with $f(A)\subseteq B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the induced ring map $\mathcal O_S(B)\to\mathcal O_X(A)$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] and quasi-finite at every prime of $\mathcal O_X(A)$ [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime]; (3) there are open coverings $S=\bigcup_jB_j$ and $f^{-1}(B_j)=\bigcup_iA_{ji}$ such that every restriction $A_{ji}\to B_j$ is locally quasi-finite. No finiteness, separation or Noetherian hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01TK (lemma-locally-quasi-finite-characterize), equivalences (1), (2), (3); quasi-finite ring maps mean finite type and quasi-finite at all target primes.
